title: Guard rule records-page compares a stacked branch's records page against its PR's base, not main
why: A stacked lane that brings in its base PR's records page byte for byte is refused, because the rule reads main only through resolve_default_base.
note: Filed 09:31 CST Nov 8 (coordinator 09:30 CST, under item 410 a). records_page_hit in hooks/guard_merge.py. Red case: lane round-one-reset merged #1957's head into #2062 (stacked on #1957); `git diff origin/fix-chain-fresh-rounds -- docs/records.md` is empty, yet the commit was refused. No lane is in that code, so lane round-one-reset (session_013NEJKzZtu1sv8D47NpC3yx) takes it (coordinator). Work-around today: take main's page and let the merge tool rebuild it.
